kids.chars: Research — the owner's session plan: twelve tasks, each with a budget and a pass criterion; nothing below has been run

kids.name: words
kids.chars: Budgets and thresholds are `(heuristic)` planning values, not a benchmark or a measurement. Setup and consent take 3 minutes and the debrief 2; the tasks below total 38; a session totals 43 minutes. A task that overruns its budget is cut, never extended. A session running late drops T7, then T6, then T10 (marked "not run" on the sheet); T1, T8, T9 and T11 are never dropped (RQ1, AC 2, AC 3, AC 5).

kids.name: words
kids.chars: The composite task (T4) never directly follows the session task (T2); T8 always follows T2 and T4; greyscale is always last. Validity limits: three sessions cannot counterbalance nine tasks — this is a rotation, not a Latin square, and the T2 / T4 order rule is the only ordering constraint met; density is confounded with participant (sessions 1 and 3 compact, session 2 dense), so no density effect can be separated from a person.

words.chars: Per session: date, initials, persona, density, input (mouse / screen reader), "stimuli: synthetic documented-shape fixtures". Per task: success / partial / fail, time to answer, help given, the verbatim words of any misread, "volunteered" or "answered when asked" (T8), any task cut or not run, and the count of mode switches (for §6.7). Two coders code the transcripts independently and reconcile; an interim ruling becomes final only when both coders agree and the owner approves. A PD whose check the sessions contradict is rewritten by the rule in §10.3's table, not dropped silently.
